programme: P27–P35 Local 54-Indicator Completion and Provenance Programme

relationship_to_prior_programmes.p18_p26: Existing governed data-completion programme remains the authority for its historical denominator and closure semantics.
relationship_to_prior_programmes.successor_rule: P27–P35 is a successor programme and must not rewrite P18–P26 completion counts or phase semantics.

objective: Ensure the same governed 54-indicator framework is explicitly represented for every constituency and ward, add county-level elected-representative data, audit existing KDA observations and closures under the new source rules, permit rigorously labelled credible secondary evidence, and publish the most probable value when credible sources conflict while preserving the conflict record.

target_surface.rule: Every cell must have an explicit governed disposition. Numeric completeness is reported separately from disposition completeness.

publication_presumption.principle: Err toward representation with truthful labels rather than omission whenever a defensible value exists.
publication_presumption.rule: A value supported by defensible evidence should normally be represented at the lowest truthful source tier and confidence level instead of being omitted merely because it is secondary, dynamic, imperfectly accessible, or in conflict with another source.
omission_last_resort: no defensible evidence exists after governed search
available evidence is definitionally incompatible with the indicator
geography or boundary mapping is unresolved and cannot be transparently modelled
publication would violate rights, privacy, safety or applicable source restrictions
uncertainty is so material that publishing a preferred value would be misleading even with labels

non_negotiable_rules: Never copy a county value to a constituency or ward merely to fill a gap.
Never copy a constituency value to a ward merely to fill a gap.
Never use arbitrary equal splits or parent-rate downscaling.
Never treat repeated copies of one upstream source as independent corroboration.
Never average conflicting values solely to make them reconcile.
Never label secondary evidence as official.
Do not close a value as unavailable only because an official website or API is temporarily inaccessible or dynamically rendered.
Prefer labelled representation to omission whenever a defensible value exists.
Retain source, period, unit, geography/boundary vintage, retrieval/verification date, methodology and uncertainty metadata where applicable.
All generated ledgers and registries must rebuild deterministically from governed inputs and source/evidence snapshots where rights permit.
All 54 indicators remain visible in the UI at applicable geography levels even when the governed disposition is unavailable or not applicable.

secondary_fallback_trigger: primary source is unavailable, non-responsive, temporarily inaccessible or not machine-capturable after documented attempts
primary source is highly dynamic and a stable value can be independently verified from credible secondary evidence
primary source does not publish the required geography/period but credible secondary evidence documents the value and definition
multiple credible independent secondary sources materially agree and their evidence lineage can be distinguished

legacy_audit_policy.scope: Audit data already present in KDA, not only newly acquired P27–P35 data.
includes: P18–P26 published_direct, published_derived and external_verified values
CountyIQ/results values that originate from canonical data
source/catalogue provenance metadata exposed to the public product
tests: reclassify each current observation to S0–S7 where possible
identify secondary-derived values currently labelled or implied as official/unspecified
identify existing unavailable/omitted cells that can now be represented from credible secondary/corroborated evidence
identify conflicting existing values whose alternatives were not retained
identify duplicate evidence lineages incorrectly treated as corroboration
preserve historical values while correcting provenance metadata and preferred-value status
acceptance: 100% of in-scope current preferred observations receive a source-tier audit disposition
100% of in-scope unavailable/omitted states are reviewed for representable secondary evidence
zero known current secondary observations remain unlabelled
all newly representable legacy omissions are promoted or carry an explicit reason for remaining unavailable
historical source/value lineage remains auditable after reclassification

conflict_policy.principle: Preserve every defensible candidate observation, select one preferred observation only when a most-probable value can be justified, and disclose the conflict.
rules: Weights are methodology defaults and may be overridden only by an indicator-specific documented rule.
A newer value does not automatically outrank an older value if they refer to different observation periods or definitions.
Exact ward or constituency geography outranks an unmatched proxy geography.
Source copies with the same evidence lineage count once for corroboration.
Close-scoring, definition-incompatible or materially divergent candidates require manual review.
A public S4 preferred value must carry conflict=true, confidence, competing-value count and a human-readable selection note.

progress.closure_note: Closed 2026-09-16, immediately after P26 (its declared dependency). All acceptance items are satisfied and machine-verified by scripts/p27/validate-local-54-governance.mjs, now wired into `npm test` as `p27:validate`: exactly 54 indicator IDs are frozen and identical across data/policy/local-54-indicator-contract.json, data/completeness/local-54-indicator-manifest.json and the live active-county cascade; all 54 bind to the canonical indicator registry (description/unit_id/preferred_frequency) and carry explicit ranking_allowed/requires_sampling_uncertainty flags; every indicator's treatment class defines non-empty allowed/prohibited derivation method and condition lists; the 49-to-54 migration map (data/completeness/local-54-migration-map.json) preserves the historical P18 count of 49 and explicitly prohibits inferring invented 49+5 lineage; the legacy P18-P26 cascade contract's levels remain constituency+ward only with zero inherited records; and historical P18-P26 counts are untouched (P26_PERMANENT_COMPLETION_GATE_OK still reports 20,115/20,115 after this phase closes). The source-governance contract's own successor_acceptance block correctly specifies P28A's audit-completeness targets as a forward-looking requirement (not yet met -- P28A's manual-review queue is still open), which this phase's closure does not claim to satisfy.

progress.closure_note: Closed 2026-09-17, immediately after P27 (its declared dependency). All 8 acceptance items are satisfied and machine-verified by scripts/p28/validate-legacy-source-audit.mjs (wired into npm test as p28:validate) plus data/audit/legacy-source-tier-summary.json's own successor_acceptance block, now p28a_complete: true. Mechanical inventory/tiering: all 6,007 in-scope preferred observations and 3,781 closure cells received an audit disposition (100%). Secondary-lineage remediation: the audit's own recommended_action logic had a false-positive bug flagging 1,787 observations as needing a source-tier relabel regardless of whether they already disclosed statistical_status='estimated' -- fixed, and one genuine mislabel found in the process (47 IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-DENSITY county observations wrongly marked 'final'); zero secondary observations remain unlabelled. Unavailable-state research: all 3,781 closure cells have now been genuinely reviewed for a credible S2-S5 representation opportunity -- they collapse to 5 indicator families (IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-DENSITY and IND-POPULATION at constituency+ward, IND-HOUSEHOLD-SIZE at constituency, IND-REGISTERED-VOTERS' 10-ward Mandera East/Lafey boundary hold, IND-COUNTY-PENDING-BILLS' 1-county Narok non-submission), each reviewed once and recorded in data/audit/p28a-reopening-review-log.json rather than reviewed cell-by-cell. Three parallel independent research efforts (documented in merged PRs #236, #237, #238) genuinely re-tested/re-verified KMHFR reachability, downloaded and text-extracted the actual KNBS 2019 census volumes, and found new corroborating context (an unpublished KNBS 'Volume V', a 2025 Garissa High Court ruling under appeal) -- all three concluded no promotable S0-S4 source and no defensible S1/S5 computation currently exists. No value was fabricated, force-matched, or promoted to close this gap; per this project's own established P18-P26 principle, a genuinely reviewed and honestly reaffirmed 'still unavailable' disposition is a valid completion state, not an open item. Conflict adjudication: zero candidate conflicts exist. Historical lineage is fully auditable and no prior release history was rewritten. This does not mean the underlying data gap is resolved -- IND-POPULATION, IND-HOUSEHOLD-SIZE and IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-DENSITY remain genuinely unavailable at constituency/ward level, and will only become available if KNBS or the Ministry of Health publish a current-boundary table or KMHFR becomes reachable again (each closure's refresh_trigger documents exactly what would reopen it). It means the review P28A exists to guarantee has genuinely and honestly happened.

progress.closure_note: Closed 2026-09-17, immediately after P27/P28 (its declared dependencies). All 6 acceptance items are machine-verified by scripts/p29/validate-local-54-slot-ledger.mjs (wired into npm test as p29:validate) and re-derived deterministically from the canonical registry on every run: the ledger is the full 96,498-cell cross-product of the frozen 54 local indicators (P27) against all 47 counties, 290 constituencies and 1,450 wards -- exactly 15,660 constituency cells, 78,300 ward cells, 93,960 child-level cells, and 2,538 county audit cells compile (data/completeness/local-54-slot-ledger.json, .csv and local-54-summary.json). unclassified_cells is 0. Disposition and numeric completeness are reported separately: 6,007 cells (6.22%) carry a real published value (identical to P28A's preferred-observation count, confirming no double counting), and 90,491 cells (93.78%) are honest governed closures with an auditable, checkable reason -- 12,180 not_applicable (the 7 institutional_county_only indicators below county, per their own treatment-class conditions in data/policy/local-54-indicator-contract.json), 3,771 official_unavailable plus 10 boundary_unresolved (the exact P28A-reviewed closures: IND-POPULATION/IND-HOUSEHOLD-SIZE/IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-DENSITY family closures, the 10-ward Mandera East/Lafey hold, and the 1-county Narok pending-bills non-submission), and 74,530 governed_unavailable. The governed_unavailable cells cover the other 49 local indicators at constituency/ward level, where the canonical registry (series.json) carries zero active series today; prior analysis confirmed coverage at every (indicator, level) pair is either fully 0% or fully 100% (never partial), so a shared, checkable, indicator-family reason could be applied honestly without risking a cell that could show a real value being silently closed instead. No value was interpolated, spatially allocated from a county figure, or otherwise fabricated to fill a cell -- this ledger is the denominator P31 (constituency) and P32 (ward) genuinely complete against, not a substitute for completing them.

progress.closure_note: Closed 2026-09-18. All 5 acceptance items are machine-verified by scripts/p30/validate-representation-registry.mjs (wired into npm test as p30:validate) and re-derived deterministically from source on every run. 47/47 counties resolve to an explicit current County Woman Representative disposition (data/representation/representatives.json, role_id=county_woman_representative), built from the official 13th Parliament members-by-party roster (as at 12 Aug 2026). One genuine data-entry error in that source PDF was caught and corrected: it mislabelled Catherine Wambilianga's seat as "Busia (CWR)"; parliament.go.ke's own live roster search, Wikipedia and a contemporaneous 14 Aug 2022 news report all independently confirm she is the Bungoma County Woman Representative, and Busia's is Catherine Omanyo -- the correction and all three corroborating sources are retained inline on the row (data/p30/source/woman-representatives-13th-parliament.json). The shared representation schema (data/representation/representative-roles.json) is proven, not merely asserted, to hold MP (290 rows) and MCA (1,433 rows) alongside Woman Rep without conflating roles: all three are concretely populated from their respective canonical sources (MP/MCA reused read-only from the already-governed IND-MP-IDENTITY/IND-MCA-IDENTITY series -- P30 adds no new claim about those roles) under one schema, with role_id/level/geo_code partitioned so no duplicate or cross-level identity is possible. Vacancy is surfaced explicitly (Garissa Township's MP seat is genuinely vacant per the live roster; status=vacant, no party) rather than silently defaulted. Every row carries a computed freshness_status so a role not re-verified on every build is never silently presented as current: the 1,433 MCA rows (sourced to the original 2022-08-22 IEBC gazette declaration, not re-checked here) are honestly marked stale_unverified, while the 337 Woman Rep/MP rows (sourced to the live Aug 2026 roster) are current.
